parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The username of the cluster management system to be reset. If no user has been created for the HBase instance, the default username is **root**.

parameters.name: AccountPassword
parameters.description: The new password for the target username of the cluster management system. The password must be 2 to 30 characters in length and must contain one or more of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, special characters, and digits. Supported special characters are underscores (_) and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the target instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.
